iOS · Offline Business English RPG + FSRS

Executive Reborn — Learn Real Workplace English Through Story

Executive Reborn
 is an offline-first business English learning app by Fawnfell. Built for busy professionals who dislike dry textbooks, it combines 58 interactive corporate story episodes, 1,397 workplace phrases, and an FSRS spaced-repetition engine with 11,250 AAC voice clips.

How Executive Reborn Combines Listening, Reading & Memory

Every study loop pairs your Shiba companion Marshal with concise workplace dramas covering boardrooms, vendor audits, contracts, and crisis calls across roughly 230 MB of offline audio and art.

Story

58 Interactive Episodes

42 main episodes (EP01–EP42) plus 16 side-story visual novel chapters with branching dialogue and native line-by-line audio.

See Free Preview

Vocabulary

1,397 Curated Phrases

Grounded in the NGSL (2,809 words) and TSL (1,250 words) frequency lists, paired with 11,250 AAC word and gloss clips.

Open Wordlist Licenses

Memory

FSRS Spaced Repetition

Powered by the open-source Free Spaced Repetition Scheduler (FSRS), keeping every learned word permanently unlocked.

How Review Works

“All words studied in Executive Reborn remain permanently available in the FSRS review queue even if a monthly subscription expires.”

— Fawnfell Product Charter · Powered by open-source FSRS & NGSL/TSL corpora

Focused TOEIC® Prep Scope: Part 3 Dialogues & Part 7 Business Reading (What Is—and Isn’t—Included)

Instead of acting as an all-parts mock-exam bank, 
Executive Reborn
 deliberately concentrates on the two sections professionals struggle with most in real work: 
extended workplace conversations (40 Part 3 dialogues + 2 Part 4 talks)
 and 
business document comprehension (42 core readings + 150 Part 7 workplace documents across 8 genres: email, notice, memo, article, advertisement, report, web page, and letter)
. It intentionally omits Part 1 photo prompts, Part 2 short Q&A, and Part 5/6 standalone grammar gap-fills, and does not predict or guarantee test scores.

Academic Vocabulary Foundation: What Are TSL 1.2 and NGSL 1.2?

Target vocabulary draws on two open academic wordlists developed by Dr. Charles Browne, Dr. Brent Culligan, and Joseph Phillips under CC BY-SA 4.0: the 
New General Service List (NGSL 1.2)
 of 2,809 high-frequency core words (reported on 
the authors’ official site
 at ~92% coverage of general English texts) and the 
TOEIC Service List (TSL 1.2)
 (reported by its authors at ~98.5%–99% combined coverage of TOEIC® test text when paired with NGSL; restructured into 1,250 core course targets here). Our derived wordlists are openly downloadable at 
Wordlist Licenses
, while all 42 scripts, 150 memos, definitions, and audio clips are original Fawnfell works.

Trademark & Non-Affiliation Notice:
 TOEIC® is a registered trademark of ETS (Educational Testing Service). Executive Reborn and Fawnfell are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by ETS.

How Does Reaction-Time FSRS-6 Work Without Self-Grading Buttons?

Executive Reborn runs the official 
FSRS-6
 scheduler (
90%
 target retention, 10-minute and 1-day learning steps) without forcing learners to self-rate 
Again / Hard / Good / Easy
. Instead, it grades every card from 
accuracy plus response latency against your own rolling median
 (last 200 correct answers under 15 s; 2,000 ms cold-start baseline): answers ≤ 0.6× median schedule as 
Easy
 (capped at 
Good
 on first encounter), 0.6×–1.5× as 
Good
, > 1.5× as 
Hard
, and misses as 
Again
.

How Many Times Does Each Word Appear in Curriculum Simulations?

The benchmarks below come from an automated 
virtual-learner simulation
 across all 42 episodes, 150 workplace reading articles, and 1,250 TSL-based target words. These figures model scheduler math and corpus frequency—they are 
not human clinical measurements
 and do not predict or guarantee TOEIC score gains.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is Executive Reborn by Fawnfell?

Executive Reborn is an offline-first business English RPG and FSRS flashcard app built by Fawnfell. It includes 42 main episodes, 16 side-story episodes, 1,397 business phrases, and full audio across Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese, and English.

How much does Executive Reborn cost and is there a lifetime option?

The first 3 main episodes and first 2 side stories are free. You can unlock all 58 episodes via a $4.99/month subscription, a $17.99 Standard Lifetime buyout, or a $24.99 Deluxe Edition with Time Wardrobe unlocks and alternate app icons.

What happens to learned vocabulary if a monthly subscription expires?

Any word you have already learned remains permanently unlocked in your FSRS review queue. Fawnfell guarantees zero lockouts on your personal spaced-repetition study history.

Does Executive Reborn work offline on commutes?

Yes. All 58 story episodes, 1,397 phrases, and 11,250 AAC word audio clips are bundled locally so commuters can study and listen with lock-screen controls without cellular data.

Does Executive Reborn use self-grading flashcard buttons or automatic reaction-time FSRS?

It uses automatic reaction-time grading with FSRS-6 (90% target retention) instead of manual Again/Hard/Good/Easy self-rating buttons. Correctness and response speed relative to your own rolling median latency (last 200 answers) automatically choose Easy, Good, Hard, or Again.

How many times does a learner encounter each word across the 42 episodes? (Simulation)

In a virtual-learner simulation at the recommended 1 episode per 2 days pace (not a human clinical trial), completing 42 episodes takes 84 days (~21.6 min/day for vocabulary and reading), with an average of 11.9 FSRS reviews per word and 4.3 encounters across audio scripts and 150 workplace articles (6.6 if articles are read twice).

Which TOEIC® parts does Executive Reborn train—and what does it exclude?

It specifically targets extended workplace listening (40 Part 3 multi-speaker dialogues + 2 Part 4 talks) and Part 7 business reading (42 core passages + 150 workplace memos/reports across 8 genres). It intentionally excludes Part 1 photo descriptions, Part 2 short Q&A, and Part 5/6 isolated grammar drills.

What does the Deluxe Edition add—and do regular users still get seasonal and holiday scenes?

Yes. All tiers (including Free Preview, Monthly Pro, and Standard Lifetime) automatically display 12 of the 13 window scenes and 9 matching Marshal outfits whenever your device calendar reaches those dates (4 seasons plus Valentine's Day, Rainy Hydrangea, Tanabata, Mid-Autumn, Halloween, Christmas, New Year's Eve, and New Year). Deluxe Edition adds the Time Wardrobe to pin any scene or outfit year-round, plus calendar-exclusive perks: Typhoon Double Rainbow window scene, 2 headphone styles (Over-ear & Neckband), and 2 alternate app icons.

iOS · オフライン完結型ビジネス英語アプリ

Executive Reborn — 企業ドラマとFSRSで続くビジネス英語

Executive Reborn
は、分厚い参考書が続かない社会人のために Fawnfell が開発したオフライン対応のビジネス英語RPG＋FSRS単語帳アプリです。本編42話＋番外編16話、1,397表現、11,250本の音声クリップを収録しています。

第1〜3話を無料試読

日本語UI（1080×1920）の実機スクリーンショットです。本編42話の会話スクリプト、職場資料リーディング、反応時間ベースの単語クイズ、通勤リスニングまで一通り確認できます。スマホでは横にスワイプしてご覧いただけます。

自己申告ボタンのない反応時間 FSRS-6 とは？

Executive Reborn は公式 
FSRS-6
（目標記憶保持率 
90%
、初期学習ステップ 10分 → 1日）を採用しています。学習者に「もう一度／難しい／普通／簡単」を毎回自己申告させる代わりに、
正誤
と
本人直近の正解反応時間（最大200問・15秒未満の移動中央値、初回20問までは基準 2,000 ms）
の比率から次回出題を自動計算します。

0.6× 以下

Easy 自動判定（初回は Good 上限）

本人の平均反応時間の 0.6 倍以内で即答できた場合のみ Easy 扱い。ただし初見語彙の偶発的な早押しを防ぐため、初日のみ Good 上限に抑えます。

0.6× 〜 1.5×

Good / Hard 自動振り分け

個人の中央値ペースを基準にするため、読むスピードや端末操作速度の個人差が打ち消され、迷って遅れた正解（1.5倍超）は自動で Hard に回ります。

誤答時

Again（10分後に再出題）

不正解は常に Again として短い再学習ステップに入り、記憶の定着度合いを単語ごとの独立曲線で再調整します。

1日どれくらいの時間で、目標語に何回出会えますか？（仮想学習者シミュレーション）

以下は 42話・150記事・1,250目標語（Browne & Culligan の 
TSL
 に基づく）を FSRS-6 の仮想学習者モデルで検証した
シミュレーション値
です（実ユーザーの臨床試験ではなく、TOEIC スコアの上昇や予測を保証するものではありません）。

仮想学習者シミュレーションによる学習ペース別ベンチマーク（実測値ではありません）

ペースモデル（仮想学習者）

劇中・記事内の遭遇/語

「本ページに記載された学習時間・復習回数・遭遇頻度はすべて FSRS-6 仮想学習者モデルによるシミュレーション値であり、実ユーザーの学習効果や TOEIC スコア向上を保証するものではありません。ただし、一度学習した単語の FSRS 復習キューは解約後も永久に無料開放されます。」

— Fawnfell 公開情報ポリシー · 出典：
TSL / NGSL 語彙ライセンス
 ＆ 
Open Spaced Repetition (FSRS)

TOEIC®対策としての専門領域：Part 3 会話 ＋ Part 7 ビジネス長文に特化

Executive Reborn は「全パート網羅の問題集」ではなく、実務で最もつまずきやすい
長めの会話リスニング（TOEIC® Part 3 相当：全42話中40話／Part 4 相当：2話）
と
ビジネス文書読解（Part 7 相当：本編42記事＋ワークデスク150記事、email・notice・memo・report・advertisement 等8ジャンル）
に絞って設計されています（個人のスコア予測やスコア上昇の保証は行いません）。
Part 1（写真描写）・Part 2（短文応答）・Part 5/6（単独文法穴埋め）はあえて収録せず
、実際の会議音声と長文メールを「意味で追い切る力」と TSL/NGSL 語彙定着に集中しています。

リスニング対策
Part 3（40話）＋ Part 4（2話）

会議・商談・アナウンス形式の連続発話を題材に、字幕付き理解と音声先行リスニングの両モードで長会話への耐性を養います。

リーディング対策
Part 7（42＋150文書 · 8ジャンル）

社内メール、規定通知、監査メモ、市場レポートなど実務文書スタイルで長文の要旨把握と重要語句の即応力を鍛えます。

収録範囲の明示
Part 1・2・5・6 単独ドリルは非搭載

基礎文法解説や短文穴埋め問題集を探している方向けではありません。ストーリー×実務長文に絞り、ミスマッチを防ぎます。

TSL 1.2 と NGSL 1.2 コーパスについて

語彙選定は、応用言語学者 Dr. Charles Browne・Dr. Brent Culligan・Joseph Phillips らが公開した学術コーパス 
NGSL 1.2
（一般英文テキストの約92%をカバーする基礎2,809語）と 
TSL 1.2
（NGSLとの組み合わせで TOEIC® テキストの約98.5〜99%をカバーすると語彙表公式サイトで紹介されているビジネス語彙体系・本アプリでは1,250目標語として再構成）をベースにしています。語彙表自体は 
CC BY-SA 4.0 ライセンスページ
でダウンロード公開し、定義・42話スクリプト・150本の読解記事・音声はFawnfellが独自制作しています。

※ 
独立性に関する注記
：TOEIC®はエデュケーショナル・テスティング・サービス（ETS）の登録商標です。Executive Reborn および Fawnfell は ETS と一切関係がなく、ETS による推奨・後援を受けたものではありません。

特典・台風一過の二重虹

カレンダー非出現（デラックス専用）

デラックス版限定（手動選択・固定）

よくある質問

Executive Reborn とはどんなアプリですか？

Fawnfell が開発する社会人向けビジネス英語RPG＋FSRS単語帳アプリです。本編42話と番外編16話、1,397語のビジネスフレーズをオフライン音声付きで収録しています。

料金体系と買い切りプランはありますか？

本編第3話・番外編第2話まで無料です。全58話の解放は月額¥780、スタンダード買い切り¥2,800、着せ替え特典付きデラックス版¥3,800から選べます。

月額プランを解約しても学習済み単語は復習できますか？

はい。一度学習した単語のFSRS復習キューは永久に無料開放されるため、解約後も復習がロックされることはありません。

FSRS-6 の復習評価は自己申告ボタンですか？

いいえ。「覚えた／迷った」を自分で押す必要はありません。正誤と本人の直近正解反応時間（中央値）との比較から、FSRS-6（目標保持率90%）が自動で次回間隔を決定します。

推奨ペースで42話を終えると単語に何回出会えますか？（仮想学習者シミュレーション）

2日に1話の推奨ペースを用いた仮想学習者シミュレーションでは、全42話の完了に約84日、1日の単語＋読解時間は約21.6分です。1語あたりFSRSで平均約11.9回復習し、音声と150本の記事内で平均4.3回出会います（実測データではなくシミュレーション結果です）。

TOEIC® のどのパートに対応していますか？（含まれる学習・含まれない学習）

リスニングは会話長文の Part 3（40話）＋アナウンスの Part 4（2話）、リーディングは実務長文の Part 7（本編42話＋ワークデスク150記事・8ジャンル）に特化しています。Part 1・Part 2 や Part 5/6 の単独文法ドリルは収録せず、実務の会議会話と社内文書読解に集中する構成です。

デラックス版の特典は何ですか？通常ユーザーでも季節や祝日の背景・衣装を見られますか？

はい。全13種の窓景色のうち12種（四季4種＋祝日8種）と対応する9種のMarshal衣装は、無料版を含む全プランで該当カレンダー日時に自動表示されます。デラックス版（¥3,800）の特典は、時のクローゼットで任意の季節・祝日背景と衣装を年間いつでも固定できる点に加え、限定窓景色「台風一過の二重虹」、ヘッドホン衣装2種、代替アプリアイコン2種です。

# Executive Reborn カリキュラム体験：本編第1〜3話＋Reading全文

Executive Reborn — 無料カリキュラム試読（本編第1〜3話・Reading・語彙リスト） | Fawnfell

日本語

インストール不要 · 本編第1〜3話（全42話より抜粋）

Executive Reborn カリキュラム体験：本編第1〜3話＋Reading全文

Executive Reborn 本編第1〜3話の無料試読ページ。取締役会や全社集会のリスニングスクリプト（英日対訳）、社内文書リーディング教材、72語のビジネス表現を確認できます。（27 会話セリフ / 13 読解テキスト / 72 語彙）

EP01 · 合併後の取締役会

EP02 · 全員大会マイクトラブル

EP03 · 経費精算の罠

料金プランに戻る

1話ごとの学習ループ構造はどうなっていますか？

Executive Reborn の全42話はすべて共通の4段階ループで構成されており、同じターゲット語彙を単語テスト・会話音声・実務メール読解の3文脈で繰り返し定着させる設計です。

Step 1
反応時間 FSRS 予習

会話と文書に出る重要単語をクイズ形式で予習。自己採点なしで反応速度から次回復習間隔を決めます。

Step 2
ストーリー＆通勤リスニング

字幕ありストーリー、またはテキスト無しの音声先行モードで職場会話の流れを掴みます。

Step 3
実務ドキュメント Reading

各話のコア文書に加え、受信トレイ・ブリーフィング・契約・人事など150本の関連記事から抜粋して精読します。

EP01 · 無料体験ユニット

EP01 · 合併後の取締役会

初めて役員会議室に座る主人公は、一夜漬けのM&A用語をきちんと説明し、CEOハリントンとCFOビクトリアの矢継ぎ早の質問の中で、初めて本物のコミュニケーションを成し遂げなければならない。

1. リスニング会話スクリプト（8 文）

Mr. Harrington
: 
Thank you all for attending. As the chairperson of this board, I find it imperative that we address the recent acquisition of Sterling Properties immediately.
皆様、お集まりいただきありがとうございます。取締役会長として、Sterling Real Estateの買収問題を早急に解決する必要があると考えております。

Victoria
: 
Agreed. The financials are... concerning. We need to know how we plan to absorb the existing debt without downsizing our core operations.
同感です。財務状況が……懸念されます。中核事業を縮小することなく、既存の負債をどう処理するのか、その道筋が必要です。

Sophia
: 
Actually, Victoria, this merger is a chance to reposition. We are merging with a prestigious firm that has an influential network in the Asian market.
Victoria、実は今回の合併は再編の好機なのです。我々は、アジア市場に強力なネットワークを持つ名門企業と合併するのですから。

Mr. Harrington
: 
Repositioning is fine, Sophia, but I need concrete numbers. Alex, as the new executive advisor, walk me through your thinking on the cost synergy.
再配置は結構です、ソフィア。ただし具体的な数字が必要です。Alex、新しいエグゼクティブアドバイザーとして、コスト相乗効果についてのあなたの考えを説明してください。

Victoria
: 
I am listening intently. Please explain how this takeover benefits the bottom line, rather than just expanding our headquarters footprint.
よく聞いていますよ。単に本社の規模を拡大するだけでなく、この買収がどのようにボトムライン（利益）を改善するのか説明してください。

Sophia
: 
Don't be so apprehensive, Victoria. The founder of Sterling was a prominent businessman who built a loyal client base. We just need to oversee the transition carefully.
そんなに焦らないでください、Victoria。Sterlingの創業者は卓越したビジネスマンであり、強固な顧客基盤を築き上げてきました。移行期間を慎重に管理さえすれば問題ありません。

Mr. Harrington
: 
Let's avoid disagreement on this point. If we cannot merge the IT systems by Q3, we risk a major operational failure. Alex, do you have a timeline?
この点では対立を避けましょう。第3四半期までにITシステムを統合できなければ、重大な運用障害のリスクがあります。Alex、スケジュールはありますか？

Victoria
: 
I require a detailed report from the presenter by Friday. Every attendee in this room expects transparency regarding the realtor commissions involved.
金曜日までに詳細なレポートを提出してください。会議に出席する全員が、不動産仲介手数料の透明性を求めています。

2. コア・リーディング教材（email）

URGENT: Q3 Merger Integration & Compliance Review

To: Executive Team
From: Emily, HR Director
Subject: URGENT: Q3 Merger Integration & Compliance Review
Dear Colleagues,
Following yesterday’s boardroom discussion, it is imperative that we align our integration strategy for the Sterling Properties merger. As many of you are aware, this takeover involves complex regulatory hurdles.
First, we must oversee the human resources transition carefully. We do not intend to downsize immediately; however, we need to absorb redundant roles into our existing structure. The founder of Sterling has agreed to stay on as an advisor for six months to ensure continuity.
Second, please note that all realtor commissions associated with the new headquarter locations must be audited by Friday. Disagreement over budget allocations has caused delays in the past. We need every attendee at the Monday meeting to review the attached financials intently.
This merger is a prominent opportunity for our company to become more influential in the commercial real estate sector. However, we cannot afford operational errors. Please treat this matter with the seriousness it deserves.
Best regards,
Emily

日本語訳を読む（URGENT: Q3 Merger Integration & Compliance Review）
宛先：経営幹部チーム
差出人：エミリー、人事部長
件名：緊急：第3四半期 合併統合とコンプライアンス監査
各位：
昨日の取締役会での議論を踏まえ、私たちはスターリング不動産合併の統合戦略を統一しなければなりません。ご承知のとおり、今回の買収には複雑な規制上の障壁が絡んでいます。
第一に、人事の移行作業を慎重に監督する必要があります。私たちは即時の人員削減を意図していません。しかし、重複するポジションを既存の組織に統合する必要があります。スターリングの創業者は、事業の継続性を確保するため、6か月間顧問として留任することに同意しています。
第二に、新しい本社所在地に関連するすべての不動産仲介手数料は、金曜日までに監査を完了する必要があります。過去の予算配分をめぐる意見の相違が、遅延を招いてきました。月曜日の会議では、出席者全員に添付の財務諸表を注意深く確認してもらう必要があります。
この合併は、当社が商業用不動産分野での影響力を高める重要な機会です。しかし、運営上のミスは許されません。この件を必ず重視してください。
敬具、
エミリー

3. ワークデスク関連ドキュメント（WORK Reading 収録テキスト）（3 本）

Upcoming Board Meeting Regarding the Harrington Merger 
受信トレイ · Part 7 · B1-B2 · 148 words

ハリントン・グループの合併案件に関する取締役会の開催通知メール。

Dear Team,
Please be advised that a critical board meeting will take place in the main boardroom this Friday at 10:00 AM. The primary agenda is to discuss the ongoing merger with Harrington Group. As an attendee, your presence is imperative because we must finalize several key strategic decisions before the end of the month.
The chairperson has requested that all senior managers prepare detailed reports on their respective departments. It is essential that you oversee any pending projects and ensure they align with our new corporate goals. Many employees feel apprehensive about potential changes, so your leadership will be vital during this transition period.
Additionally, please consult with your departmental advisor regarding any budget adjustments. We aim to maintain stability while integrating the two organizations effectively. Please confirm your attendance by replying to this email no later than Wednesday afternoon.
Thank you for your continued dedication and professionalism.

Industry Report: Major Takeover in the Real Estate Sector 
ブリーフィング · Part 7 · B1-B2 · 142 words

不動産業界の大規模買収案件に関するニュース概要。

The recent takeover of Sterling Properties by a multinational corporation has sparked widespread discussion across the industry. The founder of Sterling, a prominent businessman known for his innovative strategies, announced that the company will be absorbed into the larger entity. This decision aims to streamline operations and reduce redundant costs significantly.
According to insiders, the new headquarter will remain in the city center, but several regional offices may face downsizing. Analysts predict that this influential move will reshape the local market landscape considerably. While some stakeholders welcome the financial stability, others worry about potential job losses and cultural shifts within the organization.
The acquiring firm plans to integrate Sterling's portfolio gradually over the next two years. This strategic approach should minimize disruption for current clients and employees alike. Industry experts suggest that such consolidations are becoming increasingly common in today's competitive environment.

Marketing Strategy for the Post-Merger Brand Integration 
マーケット · Part 7 · B1-B2 · 147 words

合併後のブランド統合に関するマーケティング戦略。

Following our successful merger with Global Realty, we must develop a cohesive marketing strategy to present a unified brand image. It is crucial that we merge our digital platforms and customer databases seamlessly to enhance user experience across all channels. Our target audience includes both traditional realtors and modern property investors who value efficiency and transparency.
During the upcoming product launch event, the main presenter will outline our new service offerings to an audience listening intently. We anticipate some disagreement among stakeholders regarding the allocation of promotional budgets, but data-driven decisions should guide our final choices. Every attendee at the conference will receive a comprehensive overview of our expanded capabilities.
By leveraging our combined resources, we can establish ourselves as a prestigious leader in the commercial real estate sector. This initiative requires close collaboration between all departments to ensure consistent messaging and maximum market impact moving forward.

EP02 · 無料体験ユニット

EP02 · 全員大会でのマイクトラブル

マイクの故障、隙を狙う競合、緊急電話の三重の圧力の中で、主人公は最も簡潔な言葉で場を鎮め、合併後初の戦略発表を成し遂げなければならない。

1. リスニング会話スクリプト（11 文）

Victoria
: 
The auditorium is full. We need to delegate the tech check immediately. This inefficiency is unacceptable.
講堂は満席です。直ちに技術担当を派遣する必要があります。このような非効率は容認できません。

Mr. Harrington
: 
Victoria, please calm down. We must steer this assembly with confidence, not panic.
Victoria、落ち着いてください。パニックに陥るのではなく、自信を持ってこの集会をコントロールしなければなりません。

Sophia
: 
The main microphone is dead. If we want to elevate our brand image, we can't rely on a broken system.
メインマイクが壊れました。ブランドイメージを高めたいのであれば、故障したシステムに頼るわけにはいきません。

Victoria
: 
Then use the backup. We must streamline this process efficiently or we lose credibility.
予備の機材を使いましょう。プロセスを効率化しなければ、信頼を失ってしまいます。

Mr. Harrington
: 
Do you think we should retreat from the stage? Or reconsider our approach entirely?
舞台から降りるべきでしょうか？それとも、計画を根本から見直すべきでしょうか？

Sophia
: 
Retreat is not an option. Rumor has it the board is watching closely. We need an entrepreneur's mindset here.
撤退という選択肢はありません。取締役会も注視しているという噂です。起業家精神を持って臨む必要があります。

Victoria
: 
The coordinator is still fixing the wires. This integration is integral to our success.
コーディネーターが回線を復旧させています。今回の統合を成功させるには、これが不可欠なのです。

Mr. Harrington
: 
We need a translator for the Q&A, but more importantly, we need steady leadership.
Q&Aセッションの通訳も必要ですが、何より安定したリーダーシップが求められています。

Sophia
: 
Let's focus on the strategic value of this collaboration. Tremendous growth is possible if we act wisely.
今回の提携が持つ戦略的価値に集中しましょう。賢明に立ち回れば、大きな成長が見込めます。

Victoria
: 
Just make sure the numbers are right. We cannot afford to be inefficient again.
データの正確さだけは確保してください。これ以上の非効率は許されません。

Mr. Harrington
: 
Let's move steadily, Victoria. Steadily. Now, go to the mic.
着実に進めましょう、Victoria。着実に。さあ、マイクの前へ。

2. コア・リーディング教材（notice）

NOTICE: Post-Merger Town Hall Protocol & Strategic Alignment

To: All Staff
From: Executive Office
Date: October 24, 2023
Subject: Upcoming Town Hall Assembly and Integration Guidelines
Dear Colleagues,
As we move forward with the recent merger, it is vital that we operate efficiently to ensure a smooth transition. The upcoming town hall assembly will serve as a platform to discuss our strategic goals for the next fiscal year. All department heads are required to attend.
Please note the following protocols:
1. Delegation of Duties: Each manager must delegate specific integration tasks to their team members by Friday. This ensures that no single individual is overwhelmed and that we collaborate effectively.
2. Communication Efficiency: To streamline our internal communication, please avoid spreading unverified rumor regarding personnel changes. Official updates will only be released through the HR coordinator.
3. Strategic Focus: We must steer our resources toward areas that offer tremendous growth potential. It is integral to our success that we act wisely and maintain steady progress.
4. Technical Support: A backup microphone system has been installed in the auditorium. Should any inefficiency arise during the event, please signal the technical coordinator immediately.
We believe that through strong collaboration and an entrepreneur's mindset, we will elevate our market position. Let us reconsider any outdated practices and retreat from behaviors that hinder our progress.
Thank you for your cooperation.
Sincerely,
The Executive Team

日本語訳を読む（NOTICE: Post-Merger Town Hall Protocol & Strategic Alignment）
宛先：全従業員
差出人：執行オフィス
日付：2023年10月24日
件名：開催予定の全員大会および統合ガイドライン
各位：
最近の合併が進むにつれ、私たちは円滑な移行を確実にするために効率的に運営しなければなりません。開催予定の全員大会は、来期の戦略目標を議論する場となります。すべての部門長の出席が必須です。
以下のプロトコルにご注意ください：
1. 業務委任：各マネージャーは金曜日までに、具体的な統合タスクをチームメンバーに委任する必要があります。これにより、誰にも過重な負担がかからず、効果的に協働できます。
2. コミュニケーション効率：内部コミュニケーションを簡素化するため、人事異動に関する未確認の噂を広めないでください。公式な更新は人事コーディネーターを通じてのみ公開されます。
3. 戦略的焦点：大きな成長可能性を持つ分野へ資源を向ける必要があります。賢明に行動し、着実に前進し続けることが私たちの成功に不可欠です。
4. 技術サポート：講堂には予備のマイクシステムが設置されています。イベント中に何らかの非効率が発生した場合は、直ちに技術コーディネーターに合図してください。
私たちは、緊密な協力と起業家のマインドセットによって市場での地位を高められると信じています。時代遅れの慣行を再考し、前進を妨げる行動から離れましょう。
ご協力ありがとうございます。
敬具、
執行チーム

3. ワークデスク関連ドキュメント（WORK Reading 収録テキスト）（3 本）

Preparation for the Post-Merger Town Hall Assembly 
受信トレイ · 7 · B1 · 175 words

Alexがチームに送った、合併後の全社員集会の準備に関するメール。

As we prepare for the upcoming assembly in the main auditorium, I want to ensure every detail is handled efficiently. The recent merger has created some uncertainty, and rumors about our future direction are circulating among staff members. It is vital that we present a unified front to calm these anxieties. Please delegate specific tasks to your subordinates immediately so we can address any concerns proactively. Sarah, as the event coordinator, please verify that the microphone system is fully operational before the doors open. We cannot afford any technical glitches during this strategic announcement regarding our new market position. Our goal is to absorb the new employees smoothly and demonstrate our commitment to transparency. Let us work together diligently to make this important event a complete success for everyone involved. Furthermore, please distribute the updated agenda to all department heads by noon today. We need to streamline the Q&A session to ensure we stay within the allotted time frame. Your prompt attention to these critical matters is greatly appreciated by the entire management team.

Harrington Group's Strategic Growth Under New Leadership 
ブリーフィング · 7 · B2 · 177 words

Alexのリーダーシップのもとでのハリントン・グループの戦略的成長に関する概要。

Harrington Group has shown steady growth since the recent takeover, largely due to the visionary leadership of its founder, Alex. As a seasoned entrepreneur, Alex knows how to steer a company through turbulent market conditions. The firm has focused on building strong collaboration between departments, which has proven to be integral to their success. Analysts note that Harrington has steadily increased its market share by elevating customer service standards. The management team has wisely invested in sustainable technologies, resulting in tremendous cost savings over the past quarter. This approach not only improves profitability but also enhances the company's reputation in the global market. Experts predict that this strategic focus will continue to drive expansion in emerging sectors throughout the next fiscal year. Furthermore, the integration of new talent has been seamless, allowing the organization to absorb diverse skill sets without disrupting existing workflows. Stakeholders are particularly impressed by how quickly the executive team adapted to changing consumer demands. This agility suggests that Harrington is well-positioned to maintain its competitive edge against rival firms in the coming months.

Incident Report: Audio System Failure During Town Hall 
運営 · 7 · B2 · 182 words

全社員集会でのマイク故障に関する事故報告書。

This official report details the significant technical difficulties that were encountered during yesterday's town hall meeting. The primary microphone failed unexpectedly, causing significant disruption to the scheduled presentation and delaying the agenda. This incident highlights an inefficient process for equipment testing prior to major events. We must reconsider our current vendor contracts and streamline the setup procedure to prevent future occurrences. Additionally, the lack of a backup translator for international guests created confusion during the Q&A segment. While the speaker did not retreat from the stage, the delay undermined the professional image we strive to elevate. It is integral that we delegate responsibility for technical checks to a dedicated team member in the future. Immediate action is required to address these operational gaps and ensure reliability for upcoming assemblies. Furthermore, staff members reported frustration due to the extended pause, which allowed rumors about instability to spread rapidly. To mitigate this risk, we propose implementing a rigorous pre-event checklist that includes redundant audio systems and verified translation services. This proactive measure will help us maintain control over the narrative during critical announcements.

EP03 · 無料体験ユニット

EP03 · 経費精算の罠

外部監査の追及が迫る中、主人公は乱れた経費伝票の中から論理の穴を見つけ出し、同時にマーケティング部が公金を横領していないことをCEOに証明しなければならない。

1. リスニング会話スクリプト（8 文）

Victoria
: 
Ms. Okafor, we need to resolve these discrepancies before the close of business.
Okaforさん、終業までにこの差異を解決する必要があります。

Ms. Okafor
: 
Could you clarify the outstanding items on this invoice? The receipt does not match the total.
この請求書の未決済項目について説明していただけますか？領収書の金額と合計が一致していません。

Victoria
: 
The calculation includes a premium for emergency logistics. We had to authorize it immediately.
計算には緊急物流の割増料金が含まれています。当時は即座に支出を承認せざるを得ませんでした。

Ms. Okafor
: 
I understand, but we must audit every transaction thoroughly. Is this economically justifiable?
理解はできますが、すべての取引を徹底的に監査しなければなりません。これは経済的に妥当と言えるのでしょうか？

Mr. Harrington
: 
Well, one might argue that maximizing efficiency sometimes requires a probable increase in cost.
ええ、効率を高めるためには、時にコスト増というリスクを負う必要があると主張する人もいるでしょう。

Ms. Okafor
: 
Please subtract the personal expenses from the business overheads in your spreadsheet.
スプレッドシートの業務経費から、個人的な支出を差し引いてください。

Victoria
: 
I will allocate the remainder of the budget to cover any shortfall. The funds are sufficient.
残りの予算を割り当てて、資金不足を補います。資金は十分にあります。

Ms. Okafor
: 
Ensure the banker receives the corrected withdrawal request by noon tomorrow.
明日の正午までに、修正済みの出金申請を銀行に提出してください。

2. コア・リーディング教材（article）

Internal Memo: Guidelines for Q3 Expense Reporting and Budget Allocation

All departments must submit their expense reports by Friday. It is crucial to ensure that every invoice and receipt accurately reflects business transactions. Please use the provided calculator tool to verify your totals before submission. If you encounter an insufficient balance, do not withdraw funds personally; instead, contact the finance team to authorize a temporary overdraft.
We aim to maximize our resources while minimizing overhead costs. Therefore, employees should economize on non-essential items. When allocating budget for travel, choose economical options where possible. For instance, booking flights in advance can prevent paying a premium for last-minute changes. Remember to subtract any personal meals from your claim.
The remainder of the proceeds from our quarterly fundraise will be used to subsidize training programs. We must approximate our needs carefully to avoid inflating the budget unnecessarily. It is probable that the external auditor will conduct a thorough review next month, so please ensure all entries are economically sound. Finally, if you need to adjust a transaction, update the spreadsheet immediately and notify your banker of any pending withdrawal requests. Note that unused office equipment will be sold at auction to offset these costs.

日本語訳を読む（Internal Memo: Guidelines for Q3 Expense Reporting and Budget Allocation）
すべての部門は金曜日までに経費報告書を提出しなければなりません。各請求書と領収書が業務上の取引を正確に反映していることを確認することが極めて重要です。提出前に、提供された電卓ツールを使って合計額を確認してください。残高不足が発生した場合は、自分で引き出さないでください。代わりに財務チームに連絡して一時的な当座貸越を承認してもらってください。私たちの目標は、管理コストを最小化しながら資源の活用を最大化することです。したがって、従業員は不要なものへの支出を節約すべきです。出張予算を配分する際は、できるだけ経済的な選択肢を選んでください。例えば、航空券を早めに予約すれば、直前の変更に割増料金を払わずに済みます。個人の食費は経費申請から差し引くことを忘れないでください。四半期の募金で得た残金は研修プログラムの補助に使われます。不必要に予算を水増ししないよう、私たちはニーズを慎重に見積もる必要があります。外部監査人は来月、徹底的な審査を行う可能性があるため、すべての項目が経済的に合理的であることを確認してください。最後に、取引の調整が必要な場合は、直ちにスプレッドシートを更新し、保留中の引き出し依頼について銀行の担当者に通知してください。未使用のオフィス機器は、これらのコストを相殺するためオークションで売却されます。

3. ワークデスク関連ドキュメント（WORK Reading 収録テキスト）（4 本）

Urgent: Audit Preparation and Expense Reports 
受信トレイ · 7 · B1-B2 · 167 words

Alexが財務責任者から受け取った、外部監査への対応として経費精算書類の整理を求める緊急メール。

Subject: Urgent: Audit Preparation and Expense Reports
Dear Alex,
As you know, the external auditors will arrive next Monday to conduct a thorough review of our financial records. We must ensure that every transaction is documented accurately. Please check your outstanding invoices and receipts immediately.
I noticed that some recent expenses lack proper authorization. You need to authorize these items before submitting them. Also, please use the calculator in the attached spreadsheet to verify your calculations. If any amount seems insufficient or incorrect, let me know right away.
We must allocate enough time for this process. It is probable that the auditors will ask detailed questions about our overhead costs and any premium charges. Please economize on non-essential spending until the audit is complete.
Additionally, please coordinate with the marketing team to reconcile their travel expenses. The CEO expects a clean report by Friday afternoon. Failure to comply may result in delayed reimbursements for the entire department.
Thank you for your cooperation.
Best regards,
Sarah Jenkins
CFO

Strategic Asset Liquidation Report 
ブリーフィング · 7 · B1-B2 · 163 words

会社が遊休資産の競売によって資金を調達することに関する業界概要。

Industry Brief: Strategic Asset Liquidation
Harrington Group recently announced plans to hold a public auction for its surplus machinery and office equipment. The primary goal is to maximize revenue from these non-core assets before the fiscal year ends. A senior banker from our partner institution advised that the timing of any cash withdrawal is critical for maintaining healthy liquidity ratios.
After a detailed calculation involving depreciation and market trends, the finance team expects a significant remainder once all operational debts are settled. This strategic move will help the company fundraise for its upcoming green energy initiative without taking on new debt. However, industry experts warn that it is difficult to approximate buyer interest accurately during such volatile economic periods. The board remains optimistic about the final results.
Furthermore, the legal team will review all contracts to ensure compliance with local regulations. Stakeholders are encouraged to attend the briefing session next week for further details on the allocation of proceeds and future investment plans.

Competitor Pricing Strategy Analysis 
マーケット · 7 · B1-B2 · 151 words

競合他社が経費の削減と補助の戦略によって低価格を維持している方法の分析。

Market Watch: Competitor Pricing Strategies
Our main competitor has adopted a highly economical business model to capture market share in the retail sector. They have significantly reduced their overhead by moving to smaller office spaces and automating customer service channels. However, internal reports suggest their current cash flow is insufficient for long-term sustainability and rapid expansion.
Using a detailed spreadsheet, we can subtract their known operational costs from their selling price to estimate profit margins effectively. Some analysts believe they may inflate prices once smaller competitors exit the market due to financial pressure. It is not economically viable for them to subsidize customers indefinitely without raising rates eventually.
We should monitor their quarterly reports closely and prepare a counter-strategy. Additionally, we must consider the impact of supply chain disruptions on their inventory levels. A thorough review of their recent transactions reveals potential weaknesses in their vendor relationships that we can exploit.

Service Agreement Terms and Conditions 
契約書 · 7 · B1-B2 · 150 words

サービス契約における費用の決済、監査権、資金配分に関する条項の説明。

Contract Clause 4.2: Financial Settlement and Audit Rights
The Client agrees to allocate funds for the project within ten days of signing the agreement. Any remainder of the budget after successful completion will be returned to the Client promptly. The Contractor must economize on resources to maximize efficiency and deliver high-quality results.
If the initial payment is insufficient to cover unexpected costs, the Client must cover the difference within five days. We will subtract any penalties for delays from the final amount due. To fundraise for additional features not included in the original scope, a separate agreement is required. All financial data must be recorded in a shared spreadsheet for transparency.
Furthermore, the Client reserves the right to conduct an annual review of these terms. Both parties should communicate regularly to address any concerns regarding payment schedules or deliverables. This clause ensures fairness and clarity throughout the duration of the partnership.

# Executive Reborn — 스토리에 몰입하며 익히는 실전 비즈니스 영어

Executive Reborn — 비즈니스 영어 스토리 RPG | Fawnfell

iOS · 오프라인 비즈니스 영어 스토리 RPG

Executive Reborn — 스토리에 몰입하며 익히는 실전 비즈니스 영어

Executive Reborn
은 본편 42화 + 번외편 16화(총 58화)의 직장 드라마와 FSRS 간격 반복 학습, 1,397개 비즈니스 표현 및 11,250개 오프라인 음성을 결합한 비즈니스 영어 학습 앱입니다.

본편 1–3화 + 번외편 1–2화 + 학습한 단어 FSRS 복습 영구 무료

스탠다드 전체 + 타임 옷장(의상 11종·풍경 13종 상시 고정) + 대체 앱 아이콘

자주 묻는 질문

Executive Reborn은 어떤 앱인가요?

Fawnfell이 개발한 직장인 대상 오프라인 비즈니스 영어 스토리 RPG 및 FSRS 단어 학습 앱입니다. 총 58화와 1,397개 비즈니스 표현을 수록했습니다.

일시불(영구 소장) 구매가 가능한가요?

본편 3화와 번외편 2화는 무료이며, 월간 구독(₩7,500), 스탠다드 일시불(₩27,000), 디럭스 에디션(₩36,000) 중 선택할 수 있습니다.

이미 학습한 단어는 구독이 끝나도 복습할 수 있나요?

네. 이미 학습한 단어의 FSRS 복습 큐는 구독 상태와 무관하게 영구 무료로 유지됩니다.

# New General Service List (NGSL) 1.2 — 署名与相同方式共享

**来源**：New General Service List v1.2，作者 Dr. Charles Browne、Dr. Brent Culligan、Joseph Phillips（2013）
**获取地址**：http://www.newgeneralservicelist.org/
**许可**：Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International（CC BY-SA 4.0）
**许可全文**：https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

## 本项目使用了什么

- NGSL 1.2 的 **2,809 个词头及其 SFI 排名与频次数据**，按官方排名切分为四个学习档（band）。

## 本项目没有使用什么

- NGSL 官方未随词表发布释义文件；本项目**没有**从任何第三方"NGSL 日文版/中文版"词表抓取内容。
- 未使用 NGSL 的例句（官方列表不含例句）。

## 我们做了哪些修改

- 按官方 SFI Rank 切分为 `1-500` / `501-1000` / `1001-1800` / `1801-2809` 四档，与分班测试一致。
- 词性、英文释义、中文/日文/韩文释义、例句由本项目管线生成（Gemini flash-lite 直出 + 抽检）。
- 前 287 个功能词（the / be / and 等）保留在数据中但标记 `fw: true`，不进入学习队列。

## 相同方式共享（ShareAlike）

依据 CC BY-SA 4.0 第 3(b) 条，**由 NGSL 词表衍生的词表部分**以 CC BY-SA 4.0 提供：

- 纯词表：`licenses/wordlist-ngsl.txt`
- 词卡数据中的词头集合：`app/assets/content/decks/ngsl.json` 的 `word` 字段

## 不在此许可范围内的内容

词性判断、四语释义、例句、音频、App 代码为独立作品，不适用 CC BY-SA，权利由本项目作者保留。

## 建议的署名文本（App 内使用）

> Browne, Dr. Brent Culligan and Joseph Phillips, used under the Creative Commons

> by SFI rank; parts of speech, definitions and examples written for this app.

# TOEIC Service List (TSL) 1.2 — 署名与相同方式共享

**来源**：TOEIC Service List v1.2，作者 Dr. Charles Browne、Dr. Brent Culligan
**获取地址**：http://www.newgeneralservicelist.org/
**许可**：Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International（CC BY-SA 4.0）
**许可全文**：https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

## 本项目使用了什么

- TSL 的 **1,250 个词头（headwords）及其排名/频次排序**。

## 本项目没有使用什么

- TSL 官方的英文释义（`TSL_12_definitions.xlsx`）**未随 App 分发，也未作为生成新释义的模型输入**。
- TSL 的例句、语料原文均未使用。

## 我们做了哪些修改

- 从中选取 1,250 个词头作为课程词表（与 TSL 1.2 的规模一致）。
- 英文释义由本项目管线重新撰写（本地 `qwen3.6:27b-bf16`，仅输入单词、词性、课程例句与搭配，不输入 TSL 释义）。
- 中文释义由同一管线生成；日文、韩文由 Gemini 生成后经抽检校订。
- 例句取自本项目原创的 42 集剧情。

## 相同方式共享（ShareAlike）

依据 CC BY-SA 4.0 第 3(b) 条，**由 TSL 词表衍生的词表部分**以 CC BY-SA 4.0 提供：

- 纯词表：`licenses/wordlist-tsl.txt`
- 词典数据中的词头集合：`app/assets/dictionary/dictionary.json` 的键集合

上述词表可以自由复制、修改、再分发，条件是保留本署名并以相同许可共享。

## 不在此许可范围内的内容

本项目的英文释义、例句、42 集剧情、角色设定、配音、美术、App 代码均为独立作品，
**不因使用 TSL 词表而适用 CC BY-SA**，其权利由本项目作者保留。

## 建议的署名文本（App 内使用）

> Vocabulary based on the TOEIC Service List (TSL) v1.2, developed by Dr. Charles Browne
> and Dr. Brent Culligan, used under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0
> International License. Changes: word list kept at 1,250 headwords; definitions and
> examples written for this app; Chinese, Japanese and Korean glosses added.

Executive Reborn Curriculum Architecture & Free Sample (EP01–EP03)

Read the complete free preview of Executive Reborn Episodes 1–3: boardroom listening scripts, 10+ workplace reading memos, and 72 curated TSL/NGSL phrases.（27 dialogue lines / 13 reading texts / 72 target words）

EP01 · The Post-Merger Boardroom

EP02 · Town Hall Mic Drop

Plans & Pricing

How Is Each Episode Structured Across Listening, Reading & Vocabulary?

Every episode across all 42 main chapters follows a uniform four-step workplace loop so target TSL/NGSL terms reappear naturally across spoken audio, story scripts, and inbox reading memos.

Step 1
Reaction-Time FSRS Warm-Up

Pre-study the episode's 21–29 target phrases with latency-based FSRS-6 scheduling (no manual rating buttons).

Step 2
Boardroom Dialogue & Audio

Listen to native boardroom exchanges either with bilingual script support or audio-first commute playback.

Step 3
Multi-Feed Workplace Reading

Read the core episode memo plus linked inbox, briefing, marketing, HR, and operations documents with live term highlights.

EP01 · Free Curriculum Unit

EP01 · The Post-Merger Boardroom

Workplace English story unit covering The Post-Merger Boardroom (executive_lounge).

1. Workplace Listening Script（8 lines）

Mr. Harrington
: 
Thank you all for attending. As the chairperson of this board, I find it imperative that we address the recent acquisition of Sterling Properties immediately.

Victoria
: 
Agreed. The financials are... concerning. We need to know how we plan to absorb the existing debt without downsizing our core operations.

Sophia
: 
Actually, Victoria, this merger is a chance to reposition. We are merging with a prestigious firm that has an influential network in the Asian market.

Mr. Harrington
: 
Repositioning is fine, Sophia, but I need concrete numbers. Alex, as the new executive advisor, walk me through your thinking on the cost synergy.

Victoria
: 
I am listening intently. Please explain how this takeover benefits the bottom line, rather than just expanding our headquarters footprint.

Sophia
: 
Don't be so apprehensive, Victoria. The founder of Sterling was a prominent businessman who built a loyal client base. We just need to oversee the transition carefully.

Mr. Harrington
: 
Let's avoid disagreement on this point. If we cannot merge the IT systems by Q3, we risk a major operational failure. Alex, do you have a timeline?

Victoria
: 
I require a detailed report from the presenter by Friday. Every attendee in this room expects transparency regarding the realtor commissions involved.

2. Core Episode Reading（email）

URGENT: Q3 Merger Integration & Compliance Review

To: Executive Team
From: Emily, HR Director
Subject: URGENT: Q3 Merger Integration & Compliance Review
Dear Colleagues,
Following yesterday’s boardroom discussion, it is imperative that we align our integration strategy for the Sterling Properties merger. As many of you are aware, this takeover involves complex regulatory hurdles.
First, we must oversee the human resources transition carefully. We do not intend to downsize immediately; however, we need to absorb redundant roles into our existing structure. The founder of Sterling has agreed to stay on as an advisor for six months to ensure continuity.
Second, please note that all realtor commissions associated with the new headquarter locations must be audited by Friday. Disagreement over budget allocations has caused delays in the past. We need every attendee at the Monday meeting to review the attached financials intently.
This merger is a prominent opportunity for our company to become more influential in the commercial real estate sector. However, we cannot afford operational errors. Please treat this matter with the seriousness it deserves.
Best regards,
Emily

3. Linked WORK Desk Reading Articles（3 articles）

Upcoming Board Meeting Regarding the Harrington Merger 
收件箱 · Part 7 · B1-B2 · 148 words

Dear Team,
Please be advised that a critical board meeting will take place in the main boardroom this Friday at 10:00 AM. The primary agenda is to discuss the ongoing merger with Harrington Group. As an attendee, your presence is imperative because we must finalize several key strategic decisions before the end of the month.
The chairperson has requested that all senior managers prepare detailed reports on their respective departments. It is essential that you oversee any pending projects and ensure they align with our new corporate goals. Many employees feel apprehensive about potential changes, so your leadership will be vital during this transition period.
Additionally, please consult with your departmental advisor regarding any budget adjustments. We aim to maintain stability while integrating the two organizations effectively. Please confirm your attendance by replying to this email no later than Wednesday afternoon.
Thank you for your continued dedication and professionalism.

Industry Report: Major Takeover in the Real Estate Sector 
简报 · Part 7 · B1-B2 · 142 words

The recent takeover of Sterling Properties by a multinational corporation has sparked widespread discussion across the industry. The founder of Sterling, a prominent businessman known for his innovative strategies, announced that the company will be absorbed into the larger entity. This decision aims to streamline operations and reduce redundant costs significantly.
According to insiders, the new headquarter will remain in the city center, but several regional offices may face downsizing. Analysts predict that this influential move will reshape the local market landscape considerably. While some stakeholders welcome the financial stability, others worry about potential job losses and cultural shifts within the organization.
The acquiring firm plans to integrate Sterling's portfolio gradually over the next two years. This strategic approach should minimize disruption for current clients and employees alike. Industry experts suggest that such consolidations are becoming increasingly common in today's competitive environment.

Marketing Strategy for the Post-Merger Brand Integration 
市场 · Part 7 · B1-B2 · 147 words

Following our successful merger with Global Realty, we must develop a cohesive marketing strategy to present a unified brand image. It is crucial that we merge our digital platforms and customer databases seamlessly to enhance user experience across all channels. Our target audience includes both traditional realtors and modern property investors who value efficiency and transparency.
During the upcoming product launch event, the main presenter will outline our new service offerings to an audience listening intently. We anticipate some disagreement among stakeholders regarding the allocation of promotional budgets, but data-driven decisions should guide our final choices. Every attendee at the conference will receive a comprehensive overview of our expanded capabilities.
By leveraging our combined resources, we can establish ourselves as a prestigious leader in the commercial real estate sector. This initiative requires close collaboration between all departments to ensure consistent messaging and maximum market impact moving forward.

Word

POS

Definition

Collocation

Example

merger
noun
when one company buys another company to create one big company
corporate merger, merger agreement
Actually, Victoria, this merger is a chance to reposition.

merge
verb
to bring two things together to make one
merge into, merge systems
We are merging with a prestigious firm.

realtor
noun
a person who sells, rents out or manages property for a living
real estate agent, realtor commission
Every attendee in this room expects transparency regarding the realtor commissions involved.

takeover
noun
the buying out of one company by another
hostile takeover, takeover bid
Please explain how this takeover benefits the bottom line.

founder
noun
someone who starts a business or organization
company founder, co-founder
The founder of Sterling was a prominent businessman.

absorb
verb
to take in or soak up
absorb costs, absorb shock
We need to know how we plan to absorb the existing debt without downsizing our core operations.

downsize
verb
reduce in size or number
downsize workforce, downsize office space
We need to know how we plan to absorb the existing debt without downsizing our core operations.

advisor
noun

financial advisor, legal advisor
Alex, as the new executive advisor, walk me through your thinking on the cost synergy.

influential

We are merging with a prestigious firm that has an influential network in the Asian market.

As the chairperson of this board...

As the chairperson of this board, I find it imperative that we address the recent acquisition of Sterling Properties immediately.

We just need to oversee the transition carefully.

prestigious

We are merging with a prestigious firm that has an influential network in the Asian market.

The founder of Sterling was a prominent businessman who built a loyal client base.

apprehensive

Please explain how this takeover benefits the bottom line, rather than just expanding our headquarters footprint.

presenter

EP02 · Free Curriculum Unit

EP02 · The Town Hall Mic Drop

Workplace English story unit covering The Town Hall Mic Drop (town_hall).

1. Workplace Listening Script（11 lines）

Victoria
: 
The auditorium is full. We need to delegate the tech check immediately. This inefficiency is unacceptable.

Mr. Harrington
: 
Victoria, please calm down. We must steer this assembly with confidence, not panic.

Sophia
: 
The main microphone is dead. If we want to elevate our brand image, we can't rely on a broken system.

Victoria
: 
Then use the backup. We must streamline this process efficiently or we lose credibility.

Mr. Harrington
: 
Do you think we should retreat from the stage? Or reconsider our approach entirely?

Sophia
: 
Retreat is not an option. Rumor has it the board is watching closely. We need an entrepreneur's mindset here.

Victoria
: 
The coordinator is still fixing the wires. This integration is integral to our success.

Mr. Harrington
: 
We need a translator for the Q&A, but more importantly, we need steady leadership.

Sophia
: 
Let's focus on the strategic value of this collaboration. Tremendous growth is possible if we act wisely.

Victoria
: 
Just make sure the numbers are right. We cannot afford to be inefficient again.

Mr. Harrington
: 
Let's move steadily, Victoria. Steadily. Now, go to the mic.

2. Core Episode Reading（notice）

NOTICE: Post-Merger Town Hall Protocol & Strategic Alignment

To: All Staff
From: Executive Office
Date: October 24, 2023
Subject: Upcoming Town Hall Assembly and Integration Guidelines
Dear Colleagues,
As we move forward with the recent merger, it is vital that we operate efficiently to ensure a smooth transition. The upcoming town hall assembly will serve as a platform to discuss our strategic goals for the next fiscal year. All department heads are required to attend.
Please note the following protocols:
1. Delegation of Duties: Each manager must delegate specific integration tasks to their team members by Friday. This ensures that no single individual is overwhelmed and that we collaborate effectively.
2. Communication Efficiency: To streamline our internal communication, please avoid spreading unverified rumor regarding personnel changes. Official updates will only be released through the HR coordinator.
3. Strategic Focus: We must steer our resources toward areas that offer tremendous growth potential. It is integral to our success that we act wisely and maintain steady progress.
4. Technical Support: A backup microphone system has been installed in the auditorium. Should any inefficiency arise during the event, please signal the technical coordinator immediately.
We believe that through strong collaboration and an entrepreneur's mindset, we will elevate our market position. Let us reconsider any outdated practices and retreat from behaviors that hinder our progress.
Thank you for your cooperation.
Sincerely,
The Executive Team

3. Linked WORK Desk Reading Articles（3 articles）

Preparation for the Post-Merger Town Hall Assembly 
收件箱 · 7 · B1 · 175 words

As we prepare for the upcoming assembly in the main auditorium, I want to ensure every detail is handled efficiently. The recent merger has created some uncertainty, and rumors about our future direction are circulating among staff members. It is vital that we present a unified front to calm these anxieties. Please delegate specific tasks to your subordinates immediately so we can address any concerns proactively. Sarah, as the event coordinator, please verify that the microphone system is fully operational before the doors open. We cannot afford any technical glitches during this strategic announcement regarding our new market position. Our goal is to absorb the new employees smoothly and demonstrate our commitment to transparency. Let us work together diligently to make this important event a complete success for everyone involved. Furthermore, please distribute the updated agenda to all department heads by noon today. We need to streamline the Q&A session to ensure we stay within the allotted time frame. Your prompt attention to these critical matters is greatly appreciated by the entire management team.

Harrington Group's Strategic Growth Under New Leadership 
简报 · 7 · B2 · 177 words

Harrington Group has shown steady growth since the recent takeover, largely due to the visionary leadership of its founder, Alex. As a seasoned entrepreneur, Alex knows how to steer a company through turbulent market conditions. The firm has focused on building strong collaboration between departments, which has proven to be integral to their success. Analysts note that Harrington has steadily increased its market share by elevating customer service standards. The management team has wisely invested in sustainable technologies, resulting in tremendous cost savings over the past quarter. This approach not only improves profitability but also enhances the company's reputation in the global market. Experts predict that this strategic focus will continue to drive expansion in emerging sectors throughout the next fiscal year. Furthermore, the integration of new talent has been seamless, allowing the organization to absorb diverse skill sets without disrupting existing workflows. Stakeholders are particularly impressed by how quickly the executive team adapted to changing consumer demands. This agility suggests that Harrington is well-positioned to maintain its competitive edge against rival firms in the coming months.

Incident Report: Audio System Failure During Town Hall 
运营 · 7 · B2 · 182 words

This official report details the significant technical difficulties that were encountered during yesterday's town hall meeting. The primary microphone failed unexpectedly, causing significant disruption to the scheduled presentation and delaying the agenda. This incident highlights an inefficient process for equipment testing prior to major events. We must reconsider our current vendor contracts and streamline the setup procedure to prevent future occurrences. Additionally, the lack of a backup translator for international guests created confusion during the Q&A segment. While the speaker did not retreat from the stage, the delay undermined the professional image we strive to elevate. It is integral that we delegate responsibility for technical checks to a dedicated team member in the future. Immediate action is required to address these operational gaps and ensure reliability for upcoming assemblies. Furthermore, staff members reported frustration due to the extended pause, which allowed rumors about instability to spread rapidly. To mitigate this risk, we propose implementing a rigorous pre-event checklist that includes redundant audio systems and verified translation services. This proactive measure will help us maintain control over the narrative during critical announcements.

EP02 · The Town Hall Mic Drop — Target Phrases & Collocations

Word

POS

Definition

Collocation

Example

delegate
verb
to give others tasks to do
delegate authority/responsibility
Each manager must delegate specific integration tasks to their team members by Friday.

efficiently
adverb
to do something well in a little amount of time
operate efficiently, use resources efficiently
We must streamline this process efficiently or we lose credibility.

microphone
noun
device used by singers and public speakers to make their voice louder
adjust the microphone, check the microphone
The main microphone is dead.

coordinator
noun
someone whose job is to organize things
event coordinator, HR coordinator
The coordinator is still fixing the wires.

auditorium
noun
the area of a theater or concert hall where the audience sits
main auditorium, fill the auditorium
The auditorium is full.

steadily
adverb
in a slow and even manner
grow steadily, progress steadily
Let's move steadily, Victoria. Steadily. Now, go to the mic.

assembly
noun
when people are gathered together
town hall assembly, general assembly
We must steer this assembly with confidence.

entrepreneur
noun
a business person who starts companies
entrepreneurial spirit, successful entrepreneur
We need an entrepreneur's mindset here.

translator
noun
the person who changes something into another language
simultaneous translator, professional translator
We need a translator for the Q&A.

rumor
noun
something said by people but not necessarily true
spread rumor, unverified rumor
Rumor has it the board is watching closely.

streamline
verb
make smoother and more efficient
streamline operations, streamline procedures
We must streamline this process efficiently.

strategic
adjective
in a way carefully thought about
strategic plan, strategic goal
Let's focus on the strategic value of this collaboration.

wisely
adverb
to do something that is the right thing to do
act wisely, choose wisely
Tremendous growth is possible if we act wisely.

collaboration
noun
the act of working together
close collaboration, international collaboration
Let's focus on the strategic value of this collaboration.

steer
verb
guide the direction of
steer the meeting, steer clear of
We must steer this assembly with confidence.

tremendous
adjective
extraordinary or excellent
tremendous success, tremendous effort
Tremendous growth is possible if we act wisely.

integral
adjective
very important, necessary as part of the whole thing
integral part, integral role
It is integral to our success that we act wisely.

elevate
verb
to raise or make higher
elevate status, elevate performance
If we want to elevate our brand image, we can't rely on a broken system.

reconsider
verb
to think something over again
reconsider a decision, reconsider an offer
Or reconsider our approach entirely?

retreat
verb
to move back or withdraw from a place
retreat from the market, forced to retreat
Retreat is not an option.

inefficient
adjective
not working well or quickly
inefficient process, highly inefficient
This inefficiency is unacceptable.

EP03 · Free Curriculum Unit

EP03 · The Reimbursement Trap

Workplace English story unit covering The Reimbursement Trap (Boardroom / Finance Office).

1. Workplace Listening Script（8 lines）

Victoria
: 
Ms. Okafor, we need to resolve these discrepancies before the close of business.

Ms. Okafor
: 
Could you clarify the outstanding items on this invoice? The receipt does not match the total.

Victoria
: 
The calculation includes a premium for emergency logistics. We had to authorize it immediately.

Ms. Okafor
: 
I understand, but we must audit every transaction thoroughly. Is this economically justifiable?

Mr. Harrington
: 
Well, one might argue that maximizing efficiency sometimes requires a probable increase in cost.

Ms. Okafor
: 
Please subtract the personal expenses from the business overheads in your spreadsheet.

Victoria
: 
I will allocate the remainder of the budget to cover any shortfall. The funds are sufficient.

Ms. Okafor
: 
Ensure the banker receives the corrected withdrawal request by noon tomorrow.

2. Core Episode Reading（article）

Internal Memo: Guidelines for Q3 Expense Reporting and Budget Allocation

All departments must submit their expense reports by Friday. It is crucial to ensure that every invoice and receipt accurately reflects business transactions. Please use the provided calculator tool to verify your totals before submission. If you encounter an insufficient balance, do not withdraw funds personally; instead, contact the finance team to authorize a temporary overdraft.
We aim to maximize our resources while minimizing overhead costs. Therefore, employees should economize on non-essential items. When allocating budget for travel, choose economical options where possible. For instance, booking flights in advance can prevent paying a premium for last-minute changes. Remember to subtract any personal meals from your claim.
The remainder of the proceeds from our quarterly fundraise will be used to subsidize training programs. We must approximate our needs carefully to avoid inflating the budget unnecessarily. It is probable that the external auditor will conduct a thorough review next month, so please ensure all entries are economically sound. Finally, if you need to adjust a transaction, update the spreadsheet immediately and notify your banker of any pending withdrawal requests. Note that unused office equipment will be sold at auction to offset these costs.

3. Linked WORK Desk Reading Articles（4 articles）

Urgent: Audit Preparation and Expense Reports 
收件箱 · 7 · B1-B2 · 167 words

Subject: Urgent: Audit Preparation and Expense Reports
Dear Alex,
As you know, the external auditors will arrive next Monday to conduct a thorough review of our financial records. We must ensure that every transaction is documented accurately. Please check your outstanding invoices and receipts immediately.
I noticed that some recent expenses lack proper authorization. You need to authorize these items before submitting them. Also, please use the calculator in the attached spreadsheet to verify your calculations. If any amount seems insufficient or incorrect, let me know right away.
We must allocate enough time for this process. It is probable that the auditors will ask detailed questions about our overhead costs and any premium charges. Please economize on non-essential spending until the audit is complete.
Additionally, please coordinate with the marketing team to reconcile their travel expenses. The CEO expects a clean report by Friday afternoon. Failure to comply may result in delayed reimbursements for the entire department.
Thank you for your cooperation.
Best regards,
Sarah Jenkins
CFO

Strategic Asset Liquidation Report 
简报 · 7 · B1-B2 · 163 words

Industry Brief: Strategic Asset Liquidation
Harrington Group recently announced plans to hold a public auction for its surplus machinery and office equipment. The primary goal is to maximize revenue from these non-core assets before the fiscal year ends. A senior banker from our partner institution advised that the timing of any cash withdrawal is critical for maintaining healthy liquidity ratios.
After a detailed calculation involving depreciation and market trends, the finance team expects a significant remainder once all operational debts are settled. This strategic move will help the company fundraise for its upcoming green energy initiative without taking on new debt. However, industry experts warn that it is difficult to approximate buyer interest accurately during such volatile economic periods. The board remains optimistic about the final results.
Furthermore, the legal team will review all contracts to ensure compliance with local regulations. Stakeholders are encouraged to attend the briefing session next week for further details on the allocation of proceeds and future investment plans.

Competitor Pricing Strategy Analysis 
市场 · 7 · B1-B2 · 151 words

Market Watch: Competitor Pricing Strategies
Our main competitor has adopted a highly economical business model to capture market share in the retail sector. They have significantly reduced their overhead by moving to smaller office spaces and automating customer service channels. However, internal reports suggest their current cash flow is insufficient for long-term sustainability and rapid expansion.
Using a detailed spreadsheet, we can subtract their known operational costs from their selling price to estimate profit margins effectively. Some analysts believe they may inflate prices once smaller competitors exit the market due to financial pressure. It is not economically viable for them to subsidize customers indefinitely without raising rates eventually.
We should monitor their quarterly reports closely and prepare a counter-strategy. Additionally, we must consider the impact of supply chain disruptions on their inventory levels. A thorough review of their recent transactions reveals potential weaknesses in their vendor relationships that we can exploit.

Service Agreement Terms and Conditions 
合同 · 7 · B1-B2 · 150 words

Contract Clause 4.2: Financial Settlement and Audit Rights
The Client agrees to allocate funds for the project within ten days of signing the agreement. Any remainder of the budget after successful completion will be returned to the Client promptly. The Contractor must economize on resources to maximize efficiency and deliver high-quality results.
If the initial payment is insufficient to cover unexpected costs, the Client must cover the difference within five days. We will subtract any penalties for delays from the final amount due. To fundraise for additional features not included in the original scope, a separate agreement is required. All financial data must be recorded in a shared spreadsheet for transparency.
Furthermore, the Client reserves the right to conduct an annual review of these terms. Both parties should communicate regularly to address any concerns regarding payment schedules or deliverables. This clause ensures fairness and clarity throughout the duration of the partnership.

4. Curated Episode Vocabulary（29 phrases）

EP03 · The Reimbursement Trap — Target Phrases & Collocations

Word

POS

Definition

Collocation

Example

authorize
verb
to give official permission for something
authorize a payment / authorize access
We had to authorize it immediately.

calculator
noun
a device or program that does math for you
use a calculator / online calculator
Please use the provided calculator tool to verify your totals.

banker
noun
someone who works for a bank
contact the banker / investment banker
notify your banker of any pending withdrawal requests.

economical
adjective
giving good value or service in relation to the money, time, or effort spent
economical option, economical solution
choose economical options where possible.

withdrawal
noun
the act of taking money out of a bank account
cash withdrawal / withdrawal request
notify your banker of any pending withdrawal requests.

calculation
noun
the process of calculating something
make a calculation / rough calculation
The calculation includes a premium for emergency logistics.

overhead
noun
the fixed cost of running a business, such as rent and salaries
overhead costs / reduce overhead
subtract the personal expenses from the business overheads.

remainder
noun
the part or amount that is left after the rest has been taken away
the remainder of the funds / pay the remainder
I will allocate the remainder of the budget.

premium
noun
an extra payment added to the cost of something
pay a premium / insurance premium
The calculation includes a premium for emergency logistics.

auction
noun
a public sale in which goods are sold to the highest bidder
public auction / online auction
Note that unused office equipment will be sold at auction to offset these costs.

maximize
verb
to make as large or great as possible
maximize profit / maximize efficiency
We aim to maximize our resources.

allocate
verb
to distribute resources or duties for a particular purpose
allocate funds / allocate time
I will allocate the remainder of the budget.

economize
verb
to spend money, resources, etc. carefully and not wastefully
economize on fuel / economize energy
employees should economize on non-essential items.

insufficient
adjective
not enough for a particular need
insufficient funds / insufficient evidence
If you encounter an insufficient balance...

subtract
verb
to take one number or amount away from another
subtract from / subtract costs
Please subtract the personal expenses...

fundraise
verb
to try to get money for a particular project or organization

# Executive Reborn — Privacy Policy

Executive Reborn Privacy Policy | Fawnfell

Fawnfell

Privacy Policy · プライバシーポリシー

Executive Reborn — Privacy Policy

Last updated: 2026-11-24. Executive Reborn stores learning progress locally on your device, uses no account system or ad tracking, and relies on Apple App Store and RevenueCat solely to verify optional purchases.

1. Data we collect

We do not require an account, run advertisements, or track you across other apps or websites.
 Your learning progress, settings (such as language, sound, and study schedule), and word-review history are stored locally on your device.

2. In-app purchases and subscriptions

Optional subscriptions and lifetime upgrades are processed by Apple App Store (or Google Play, where available) and validated using 
RevenueCat
. To verify purchase receipts and unlock your entitlements across reinstalls or devices, RevenueCat generates and stores an anonymous app user ID along with transaction and entitlement status. We do not receive your payment card details, Apple ID, or real name.

3. Permissions

Background audio
: used to continue playing commute and listening audio when your screen is locked or the App is in the background.

Files
: only if you choose to import a document into the reader yourself; the App reads only the file you pick, and it stays on your device.

4. Children

The App is not directed to children under 13 and does not knowingly collect personal information from anyone.

5. Changes

If the App's data practices change, we will update this policy before the change takes effect.

6. Contact

Questions or privacy requests: 
fawnfell@gmail.com

Executive Reborn — プライバシーポリシー（日本語）

最終更新日：2026年11月24日

Executive Reborn（以下「本アプリ」）は、Fawnfell が提供するビジネス英語学習アプリです。本ポリシーは、本アプリが扱うデータについて説明します。

1. 収集する情報

本アプリではアカウント登録や広告配信を行っておらず、他社のアプリやウェブサイトを横断するトラッキングも一切行いません。
学習の進捗、設定（言語・サウンド・学習計画など）、単語の復習履歴は、お使いの端末内にのみ保存されます。

2. アプリ内課金およびサブスクリプション

任意のサブスクリプションや買い切りプランの決済は Apple App Store によって処理され、購入レシートの検証と利用権の同期のために 
RevenueCat
 を利用しています。購入状態の復元および検証のため、匿名化されたアプリユーザーIDと購入・利用権のステータスが処理されますが、クレジットカード情報、Apple ID、氏名等を当方が取得することはありません。

3. 権限

バックグラウンド再生
：画面ロック中やバックグラウンド移行時に通勤・リスニング音声を再生し続けるために使用します。

ファイル
：ユーザー自身がリーダーに文書を読み込む場合に限り、選択されたファイルのみを扱い、端末内にとどまります。

4. お子様について

本アプリは13歳未満のお子様を対象としておらず、個人情報を意図的に収集しません。

5. お問い合わせ

fawnfell@gmail.com

# Executive Reborn — Support & Help

Executive Reborn Support | Fawnfell

Fawnfell

App Support · サポート

Executive Reborn — Support & Help

Need help with Executive Reborn on iOS? Restore purchases in one tap inside the app, review subscription management steps below, or reach Fawnfell directly at 
fawnfell@gmail.com
.

Email Support

Privacy Policy

How do I restore purchases after reinstalling or switching iPhones?

Open 
ME → Subscription & Restore Purchases
 inside Executive Reborn and tap 
Restore Purchases
 while signed into the same Apple ID used for the original purchase.

What happens to my learned words if a monthly subscription ends?

All words you have already studied stay permanently unlocked in your FSRS spaced-repetition review queue, even if your monthly subscription expires.

How do I switch between a monthly subscription and a lifetime buyout?

Purchase the Standard or Deluxe Lifetime plan inside the app, then open iOS 
Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions
 to cancel the monthly renewal so you are not billed twice.

日本語サポート・購入の復元方法について

機種変更や再インストール時は、アプリ内の「ME」タブから「サブスクリプションと復元」を開き、「購入を復元」をタップしてください。ご不明点は 
fawnfell@gmail.com
 までお送りください。

Executive Reborn — 邊追職場懸疑劇邊練商務英語

Executive Reborn
 由 Fawnfell 打造，將 42 集主線與 16 集番外（共 58 集）職場劇情、1,397 條商務片語及 FSRS 間隔重複引擎整合為純離線通勤應用，並內建 11,250 條 AAC 語音。

常見問題

Executive Reborn 適合什麼樣的學習者？

適合不想硬啃傳統教材的職場人與商務英語學習者。全套共 58 集互動職場劇情、1,397 條核心片語並支援純離線通勤播放。

有哪些方案？支援一次買斷嗎？

前 3 集正篇與前 2 集番外免費體驗；付費提供輕量月度訂閱 NT$160/月、標準永久買斷 NT$590，以及含時光衣櫥與備用圖示的豪華典藏版 NT$790。

月費到期後，已經背過的單字會被鎖住嗎？

不會。所有已學習過的單字都會永久保留在 FSRS 複習佇列中，絕不鎖死您累積的學習進度。
